usage: Noncommercial research use; see upstream usage and license notices.
format: JSON array of objects containing messages with role and content fields
conversion: User content is stripped instruction plus two newlines and stripped input when present; assistant content is stripped output. No system prompt added.
filtering: Omit empty instructions or answers and keep the first occurrence of each exact converted user prompt before splitting.
shuffle: Python random.Random(42).shuffle; first round(5% of retained records) assigned to validation
